title.zh: 香港金管局推进全天候代币化结算，拟将稳定币纳入外汇基金票据试验
title.en: 香港金管局推进全天候代币化结算，拟将稳定币纳入外汇基金票据试验

current_state.zh: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority advanced its EnsembleTX project to 24/7 real-value tokenized settlement using tokenized central bank money as the base layer, with tokenized Exchange Fund Bill secondary-market trades completed and regulated stablecoins slated for the next trial phase, while HSBC reported its HKD stablecoin RedCoin reached 50,000 users about ten days after launch on PayMe.
current_state.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority advanced its EnsembleTX project to 24/7 real-value tokenized settlement using tokenized central bank money as the base layer, with tokenized Exchange Fund Bill secondary-market trades completed and regulated stablecoins slated for the next trial phase, while HSBC reported its HKD stablecoin RedCoin reached 50,000 users about ten days after launch on PayMe.
